parts.name: Cabinet Door (Right)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right cabinet door made of MDF, part of a storage cabinet structure.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as a movable panel that opens and closes to provide access to the cabinet’s interior.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about hinges attached to the cabinet frame, allowing it to swing open and closed.

parts.name: Cabinet Door (Left)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left cabinet door made of MDF, forming the front closure of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the left compartment of the cabinet and helps protect stored items from dust.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about hinges on the left side, opening outward for access.

parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the main structural frame of the cabinet made of plywood.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural integrity and support for the doors, shelves, and base.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that holds all other components together.

parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: This is the bottom panel of the cabinet made of plywood.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the weight of stored items and stabilizes the cabinet on the floor.
parts.Movement_description: It is a stationary part that does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: This is an internal shelf made of particle board, dividing the cabinet’s interior space.
parts.Functional_description: It provides horizontal surfaces for organizing and storing items within the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is typically fixed or adjustable vertically but does not move during regular use.
